urls.rationale: Title 21 Ch. 5 (Ethics in Government) contains Georgia's lobbyist-registration and lobbyist-disclosure provisions (Article 4 'Public Officials' Conduct and Lobbyist Disclosure', O.C.G.A. 21-5-70 et seq.).

notes: Title-21 snapshot exposes only chapter-level URLs; per pass-2 prompt rule on snapshot ground truth, propose chapter-5. Will need pass-3 to descend into Article 4 (lobbyist disclosure).
